raw_response:
This plot is only 0.55 hectares and rented, so I will not pour too much money into it, but maize in Iringa needs at least some fertilizer to produce decent cobs. I will use the voucher program to get chemical fertilizer and improved seed because the rains here are good and I want to make the most of the season. My family will do most of the work by hand-hoe, but I will hire a few laborers to help with land preparation and harvest since I am getting old and cannot bend like I used to. I do not see the need for pesticides or irrigation because the rains are reliable and we always weed by hand.
